name: PetAmberAlert
region_note: LOST AND FOUND PETS - online alert and search sites from the Mayor's Alliance lost and found page. File a report with the city's shelter as well.
notes: A paid service: a one-time alert starts at $39.95 and calls neighbours and faxes vets and shelters near where the pet was last seen. The free options above are worth trying first.
type_raw: Paid lost pet alerts by phone, fax and social media
